body.title: Save permanently corrupted for every spell-path player after foundation breakthrough (phap_tu + ngu_hanh)
body.counterexample: vitest rig: spell-path profile + foundation victory -> write+load = corrupted (100% deterministic)
body.expected: a save produced by normal play loads cleanly
body.actual: masteryGrantRecord(1|2) writes nodeLevels.tinh_thong_* but never mirrors into purchasedNodeIds -> validateGameSaveShape -> status 'corrupted' -> reload loses character. grantSkillCore writes both channels (sword/body ways unaffected)
body.rootCause: granted-node seam writes only the level channel, not the purchase ledger
body.repair: Write tinh_thong_* grants through the same both-channel path (or mirror into purchasedNodeIds at grant time); add save-shape pin for granted-node ways

body.title: perfectClearSeconds=0 writer/validator mismatch corrupts save
body.counterexample: vitest rig: spell-path profile + foundation victory -> write+load = corrupted (100% deterministic)
body.expected: a save produced by normal play loads cleanly
body.actual: writer can emit 0 (same-ms perfect clear) -> validator rejects -> 'corrupted'
body.rootCause: contract hole between writer and validator
body.repair: Floor clearSeconds at >0 epsilon or relax validator to >=0; one-sided contract
